works.author: Nixtio
works.comment: 平板上“New Swap”房产估值界面，左侧 Residential、Office、Rental 三类房源配 Building Age 滑杆与 3 卧、4/7 层，右侧曼哈顿地图标着 23 号房 $3,512,840 估价与 12Y 平均房龄；房产 App 用“一张地图 + 一个估价 + 一组筛选”把买房决策压进一屏。
works.comment_en: Real Estate App & Dashboard Design shows a “New Swap” valuation screen on a tablet: Residential, Office and Rental listings with a building-age slider, 3 bedrooms and floor 4/7 on the left, a Manhattan map on the right marking house 23 at $3,512,840 with a 12Y average age; one map, one estimate and one set of filters compress the whole home-buying decision into a single screen.
works.title: Real Estate App & Dashboard Design

works.author: Artspire
works.comment: 淡黄底配爪印暗纹，PELORA 落地页上半是主人抱着爱犬的海边大图配“More healthy years, together”，下半“Speak naturally. PELORA turns it into a clear timeline”，语音记录转成健康评分趋势与 Life timeline；宠物健康页用“一张合影 + 一段语音 + 一条时间线”把 AI 监测讲得温情可信。
works.comment_en: AI Pet Healthcare Landing Page Design sets PELORA on pale yellow with a faint paw-print pattern: a seaside photo of an owner hugging their dog under “More healthy years, together,” then “Speak naturally. PELORA turns it into a clear timeline” above a health-score trend and a Life timeline; one photo, one voice note and one timeline make AI pet monitoring feel warm and trustworthy.
works.title: AI Pet Healthcare Landing Page Design

works.author: Ronas IT | UI/UX Team
works.comment: 米白底珠宝店 Platinum 页面，大字“Bestsellers 64”配 All Jewelry、Rings、Earrings 分类，Blue Gold Ring €275、Aquamarine Silver Drops €155 等四件商品一字排开，下方 Emerald Gold Pendant €265 大图配 Add to bag；珠宝电商用“一个大标题 + 一排商品 + 一个价格”把轻奢感讲得干净利落。
works.comment_en: Jewelry Website lines up Platinum's bestsellers on warm off-white: a huge “Bestsellers 64” headline with All Jewelry, Rings and Earrings filters, four pieces in a row — Blue Gold Ring €275, Aquamarine Silver Drops €155 and more — and an Emerald Gold Pendant €265 feature with an Add to bag button; one headline, one row of products and one price each keep the luxury feel clean and shoppable.
works.title: Jewelry Website - Luxury Boutique Storefront

works.author: Bayu Aji Sadewa for Korsa
works.comment: 浅蓝天空配白云，Wellora 健康教练落地页中央“Feel better in your body. Clearer in your mind.”，下方五张运动生活照沿弧线排开，再往下“Wellness shouldn't feel like another thing to keep up with.”；健康站用“一片天空 + 一句口号 + 一条照片弧线”把轻松感讲得透亮。
works.comment_en: Wellora floats its health-coaching landing page on a blue sky with clouds: “Feel better in your body. Clearer in your mind.” in the center, five lifestyle photos arcing below, then “Wellness shouldn't feel like another thing to keep up with.”; one sky, one slogan and one arc of photos make wellness feel light and breathable.
works.title: Wellora - Health & Wellness Coaching Website Animation

works.author: Phenomenon Studio
works.comment: 碎石黑底上斜放一台笔记本，屏里“DROP 08 // INCOMING.”大字配“NEW DROP INCOMING. PREVIOUS COLLECTION – FINAL CALL. -20% OFF WHILE IT LASTS.”，下方五位黑衣模特一字排开；潮牌电商用“一块碎石 + 一句倒计时 + 一排模特”把发售的紧迫感拉满。
works.comment_en: IRON THEORY drops a laptop at an angle over shattered black stone: “DROP 08 // INCOMING.” in huge type with “NEW DROP INCOMING. PREVIOUS COLLECTION – FINAL CALL. -20% OFF WHILE IT LASTS.” and five black-clad models in a row; one slab of rubble, one countdown line and one row of looks turn a fashion drop into pure urgency.
works.title: E-commerce Website Design – IRON THEORY

works.author: Jack R. for RonDesignLab
works.comment: 黑底上手握手机，屏上“Onboarding walkthrough”音频卡片配粉色波形与 48:02 播放进度，下方“Atlas redesign”与“Q4 roadmap”两张录音卡片；AI 录音 App 用“一张波形 + 一个播放键 + 两张任务卡”把录音转文字的工作流讲得直观。
works.comment_en: Plaud shows a phone in hand on black: an “Onboarding walkthrough” audio card with a pink waveform and 48:02 of playback, above “Atlas redesign” and “Q4 roadmap” recording cards; one waveform, one play button and two task cards make the record-to-text workflow instantly legible.
works.title: Plaud — AI Recording Mobile App

works.author: Alamin Hossen
works.comment: 海上钻井平台大图打底，右侧 Equipment Details 面板列着 92°C、184 bar、Health Score 72% 与 High Temperature 警报，下方 Production Trend 曲线与 Oil Production 89,200 bbl/day；油田管理仪表盘用“一张平台大图 + 一组设备指标 + 一条产量曲线”把工业数据讲得有现场感。
works.comment_en: Oilfield Management Software sets a smart analytics dashboard over a full-bleed offshore platform photo: an Equipment Details panel reading 92°C, 184 bar and a 72% Health Score with a High Temperature alert, plus a Production Trend curve and Oil Production at 89,200 bbl/day; one platform photo, one set of equipment metrics and one production curve give industrial data a real sense of place.
works.title: Oilfield Management Software – Smart Analytics Dashboard
